decision.title: Elvis: A Legendary Performer Volume 1
tracklist: (There'll Be) Peace in the Valley (For Me)
(Now and Then There's) A Fool Such as I

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (14 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/1039295-Elvis-A-Legendary-Performer-Volume-1, https://wake.store/products/elvis-presley-a-legendary-performer-volume-1. 1974 RCA compilation (CPL1-0341) in die-cut wood-grain sleeve with 12-page 'The Early Years' booklet; contains 6 previously unreleased tracks plus two excerpts from the September 22, 1958 Army press interview (0:34 and 2:14). 14-track LP-side sequence identical across Discogs, wake.store, Citizendium and Strummer Room listings. Some CD/bootleg tracklists reorder tracks or retitle 'Tonight's All Right for Love' as 'Tonight Is So Right for Love'; the official LP sequence above is used.
